pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with softened edge gradients. Patch size increases in spatial area from the neck toward the flank, transitioning from angular to more rounded geometries.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored pathways forming clear 3-way and 4-way junction nodes. The thickness of these pathways is non-uniform, appearing wider on the flank than on the neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A fine-textured, low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the upper neck, consisting of short, dark hair filaments.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: Presence of two distinct, dark structural interruptions on the neck ridge caused by perched avian silhouettes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Several small, dark, circular punctate marks are visible on the lower ventral-flank area.
other_distinctive_markers: Two oxpecker birds are perched on the dorsal ridge of the neck.
